incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio, por el que se aprueba el texto refundido de la Ley de Sociedades de Capital (LSC); Articles 19-22 (incorporation deed), 72-80 (share capital and formation), 209-214 (administrators), 4 (limited liability).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial (Provincial Commercial Registry) of the registered office, coordinated by the Registro Mercantil Central (Central Commercial Registry) under the Spanish Ministry of Justice.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Spanish Public Deed of Incorporation) granted before a Notary Public and subsequently inscribed in the Registro Mercantil.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum share capital is EUR 3,000, fully subscribed and paid in cash or kind at incorporation. Cash contributions must be deposited in a Spanish bank account in the name of the company under formation and evidenced by a banker's certificate attached to the deed; the bank holds the funds at the notary's disposal until execution, after which they are released to the administrators. No separate escrow account is legally required for the EUR 3,000 minimum.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED FIRST: That the share capital of €3,000, divided into 3,000 equal participations, is subscribed and fully paid by the founding partners; the banker's deposit certificate is approved. RESOLVED SECOND: That the registered office is fixed at [address], Madrid, Spain, and the corporate object includes wholesale trading, storage and chartering of prilled urea, potassium chloride and other fertilizer commodities. RESOLVED THIRD: That [Name] is appointed Administrador Único with full corporate powers, and [Name] is appointed Compliance Officer, both accepting office in writing. RESOLVED FOURTH: That the Administrador is authorized to execute the public deed, obtain the NIF, file the deed at the Registro Mercantil, secure environmental and municipal licenses, and open bank accounts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain taxpayer identification number (NIE) for foreign shareholders and directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish consular office at the investor's residence or Comisaría General de Extranjería y Fronteras (National Police) in Spain
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form EX-15 requesting the Número de Identidad de Extranjero (NIE); attach valid passport, evidence of economic interest in the proposed SL (draft deed or shareholding statement), and pay Tasa 790-012. The NIE certificate must be presented to the notary at deed execution; all non-resident incorporators require a NIE before signing the deed.
required_dossiers: Valid passport or EU/EEA identity card
Evidence of economic interest in the SL
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If refused or delayed, resubmit at the provincial police station with supplementary documentation or file a recurso de alzada before the competent authority; expedited processing is available upon proof of urgency for deed signing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain negative name certificate from the Central Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (Central Commercial Registry), Madrid - online application portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online application for a certificación negativa de denominación social listing up to five proposed corporate names (e.g., FERTOPEN SL). The issued certificate reserves the approved name for three months, is renewable, and must be annexed to the notarial deed.
required_dossiers: List of five proposed corporate names
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a name is refused for similarity with an existing entity, immediately file a new application with alternative names; administrative contest is possible but refiling is faster and standard practice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open provisional corporate bank account and deposit minimum share capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish credit institution authorized by the Banco de España
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary account in the name of the future SL (company under formation), deposit EUR 3,000 as paid-up capital, and obtain a banker's certificate (certificado bancario) attesting the deposit and stating that funds are blocked until the notary executes the deed. The certificate is incorporated into the public deed.
required_dossiers: Proof of source of funds (AML due diligence)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank applies enhanced due diligence, provide source-of-wealth documentation and a corporate structure chart; alternatively, deposit the capital in the notary's escrow account and obtain a substitute certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute and authorize the public incorporation deed before a Spanish Notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notario (Spanish Notary Public) of the Colegio Notarial de Madrid
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appear before the notary with the approved name certificate, bank certificate, NIE documents, and draft bylaws. The notary verifies legal capacity, reviews the legality of the statutes and capital structure, conducts anti-money-laundering identification, and executes the Escritura Pública de Constitución. The notary then self-assesses and collects the AJD tax within 30 days.
required_dossiers: NIE certificates and passports of incorporators
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary raises a legality objection, amend the objectionable clause and re-execute the deed; material omissions are cured by means of a supplementary public deed before proceeding to registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain provisional tax identification number (NIF provisional) from the State Tax Agency
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), provincial tax delegation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days from deed execution, file Form 036 (censo de empresarios) together with a certified copy of the deed to obtain the provisional CIF/NIF. The provisional NIF is valid until the company is registered in the Registro Mercantil and must be used on all pre-registration documents.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the public deed
Proof of appointment of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If rejected, correct the Form 036 data (presentación duplicada) and resubmit; provide justification of fiscal domicile to avoid cross-checks and delays.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the company in the Provincial Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial de Madrid (or the province of the registered office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the first copy (primera copia) of the public deed to the Commercial Registry within two months of execution. The Registrar verifies the legality of the deed and inscribes the Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada; inscription confers full legal personality and definitive corporate standing.
required_dossiers: First copy of the public deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a nota de defectos, cure the defect through a supplementary notarial deed or additional documentation within the suspension period; a negative calificación registral may be appealed to the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain definitive NIF, register as employer, and file municipal activity declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT); Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS); Ayuntamiento (municipal council)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form 036 together with the Commercial Registry inscription certificate to convert the provisional NIF into the definitive NIF. Register the company as an employer with the TGSS to obtain an employer account code (código de cuenta de cotización), and submit to the Ayuntamiento a declaración responsable (responsible declaration) for the warehouse activity, attaching fire safety and technical compliance reports.
required_dossiers: Municipal activity declaration with technical annexes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipal declaration is queried, present the completed fire safety certificate and structural inspection reports; a follow-up environmental or urban-planning inspection can validate the declaration and cure the objection.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Dirección General de Producciones y Mercados Agrarios, Ministerio de Agricultura, Pesca y Alimentación (MAPA), in coordination with the regional agriculture council, the Comunidad de Madrid environmental authority, and the Ayuntamiento municipal licensing board
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Inscripción en el Registro de Establecimientos Comerciales de Productos Fertilizantes (Fertilizer Dealer Registry) and Municipal Licencia de Actividad / Declaración Responsable for the fertilizer warehouse

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico (MITECO) and the competent environmental department of the Comunidad de Madrid
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C - Simplified environmental registration: wholesale storage and chartering of prilled urea and potassium chloride is classified as non-hazardous; a full Environmental Impact Statement (Estudio de Impacto Ambiental) under Ley 21/2013 is not required below Annex II storage thresholds, and a municipal ambient license or responsible declaration suffices.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: pH 6.0-9.0, COD equal or below 500 mg/L, suspended solids equal or below 300 mg/L for discharge to municipal sewer; air emissions: particulate fertilizer dust at transfer points below 10 mg/Nm3, no fugitive ammonia exceeding 10 ppm; solid waste classified under EWC codes 02 01 99 and 20 03 99 and traceable to an authorized waste manager per Real Decreto 306/2020.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: certificate of fire protection (Certificado de Protección contra Incendios) compliant with CTE DB-SI and issued by the municipal fire brigade; structural: technical load-bearing inspection (ITEB) for palletized fertilizer racking; occupational: workplace risk prevention plan under Ley 31/1995 and Real Decreto 486/1997, implemented by an accredited external prevention service (SPA), plus occupational health surveillance for warehouse operators.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) - Official Portal: https://www.sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign or non-resident entities obtain NIF (Número de Identificación Fiscal / CIF) by registering electronically via AEAT portal or requesting appointment at a tax office with incorporation documents, passport, and proof of address; Spanish SL entities receive automatic CIF assignment upon registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box elections; hybrid mismatch adjustments available under ATAD Directive and Spanish transposition rules

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido - IVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing through SII (Sistema de Información Inmediata) platform with digital stamping and immediate reporting obligations

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate for goods exported outside the EU or offshore services upon proof of export or supply outside EU territory via customs and remittance documentation
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Retrospective clawback of zero-rated VAT plus fines up to 100% of VAT amount, interest, and potential criminal sanctions for fraudulent claims

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain) jointly with the Secretaría de Estado de Comercio through the Dirección General de Comercio Internacional e Inversiones (DGCOM) of the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Enterprise; foreign-exchange and balance-of-payments supervision is exercised under Articles 63-66 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the EU and Spanish Law 19/2003, as developed by Royal Legislative Decree 5/2005 and Bank of Spain reporting protocols.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is a fully floating and convertible currency; neither current account operations (export/import payments) nor capital account operations (equity subscriptions, shareholders’ advances, profit repatriation) are subject to prior exchange-control approval. Spain’s legal framework incorporates full EU capital freedom. Dividends, retained earnings remission, partial capital repayments and liquidation proceeds may be wired out of Spain after satisfying corporate tax (25% general rate), statutory dividend withholding (19% for residents within EU tax treaty networks or broadly 19%/25% depending on the treaty provision), and the relevant annual declaration forms (Modelo 296 / Modelo 200). The practical hurdles are not exchange-control based but documentary: beneficial ownership certification, notarial deeds, registration with the Registro Mercantil, and balance-of-payments statistical reporting when the transaction exceeds €50,000 or is considered foreign direct investment.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Spain imposes no statutory surrender requirement, no minimum conversion quota, and no forced repatriation deadline for export proceeds. A Spanish exporting SL may keep foreign currency abroad, convert it at commercial banks, or retain the proceeds as repayable director’s advances. Nevertheless, for Bank of Spain balance-of-payments statistics, every export receipt entering the national banking system must be identifiable to its underlying transaction; the receiving bank is obliged to file the corresponding electronic declaration (BDP system) with the amount, the invoicing company, and the proof of customs export (DAU). In practice, the bank will require the export invoice and the completed exchange declaration before crediting high-value MT103 settlements. Failure to correctly declare export proceeds may trigger tax risk audits and compliance fines even when no conversion obligation exists.

Capital Escrow Account and Operational Multicurrency Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: MEDIUM (conditional). Licensed European EMIs (Spanish or passporting under PSD2) can open a multi-currency IBAN remotely and provide inbound and outbound wire routing, granular FX conversion, virtual treasury cards, and fast SEPA/SWIFT processing. They are legally prohibited from granting credit and cannot issue documentary letters of credit. Since the target trade flow requires commercial LC, only an ordinary credit institution can act as the issuing and confirming arm. An EMI should therefore be used as a second-tier treasury and petty-disbursement rail, not as the primary capital escrow or trade settlement account. When using an EMI, the SL’s corporate resolutión must expressly identify the EMI as a non-credit intermediate, and all high-value transactions must be routed onward to a tier-1 bank to remain within a transparent clearance protocol.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Spanish AML law (Ley 10/2010, as amended) does not literally demand that every director appear physically at the bank branch; however, in practice tier-1 Spanish banks classify a newly incorporated SL with non-resident shareholders in the enhanced due-due diligence tier. At least one board member with full representational powers and a NIE/TIE will be required to attend a face-to-face interview in Madrid, Barcelona, or Valencia. Some banks allow an interview at their own subsidiary in the shareholder’s jurisdiction if that subsidiary operates under the same global standards. Remote video identity verification is generally insufficient for opening a capital escrow account. The mandate includes: presentation of original notarial deed, Spanish NIF, apostilled constituent documents, beneficial-ownership declarations, bank references, and a description of the fertilizer-trading business model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Registered office in Spain appears to be a virtual office or compliance mailbox without tangible operational footprint
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a certified lease agreement for a physical commercial space, minutes confirming that the SL has a local tax/operations representative, monthly payroll evidence of at least one Spanish employee, a draft distribution and storage arrangement with an independent local warehouse, and a board resolution designating Spain as the real place of effective management.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) resides in a FATF grey-list country, a non-cooperative tax jurisdiction, or a state without Spanish bank relationship
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver a substantive source-of-wealth statement signed by each UBO, a bank reference letter from the UBO’s regulated home-state bank, audited parent company financial statements, apostilled good-standing certificates, complete UBO structure chart, and declaration under Ley 10/2010 confirming absence of PEP status or any connection to sanctioned persons.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade counterparties or maritime shipping destinations trigger conflict with EU/UN/OFAC sanctions because fertilizer cargoes may be misrepresented or vessel-beneficiary ownership is opaque
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Maintain a sanctions-screening report from an independent third-party tool (World-Check, Dow Jones or S&P Global); bill of lading with vessel IMO number; certificate of origin for prilled urea and potassium chloride; final export licence from the port authority; end-client Form or affidavit confirming noagrochemical transshipment to prohibited destinations; and copies of the corresponding reinsurance certificate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large round-number inbound transfers within the first 90 days from a non-resident shareholder without transparent capital-deed correlation
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: File a notarial deed for the capital increase/contribution stating the exact amount in euros, date of disbursement, and shareholder identity; obtain the bank’s safe-keeping copy of the public deed; align all incoming SWIFT messages with the deed’s date and amount; and maintain a notarized copy of shareholder resolutions plus, where applicable, the foreign-investment registration form submitted to the Spanish commercial registry.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The non-resident shareholder must initiate a SWIFT MT103 from its own fully compliant account in the country of origin. The receiving instruction must identify as beneficiary the SL’s exact legal name and the capital escrow IBAN in Spain. The remittance field must clearly state: ‘FOREIGN DIRECT INVESTMENT – EQUITY SUBSCRIPTION / APORTACIÓN DE CAPITAL – NOTARIAL DEED NO. [X] OF [DATE]’. Spanish balance-of-payments classification must use the direct-investment purpose code ‘A.1.1 / FDI – Constitución de Sociedad’ within the Bank of Spain’s electronic declaration environment. The bank will require, before releasing the funds, the public deed of incorporation or capital increase, the provisional NIF/VAT certificate, the certificate from the Registro Mercantil, and, for funding from non-EU sources, the declaration to the DGCOM foreign-investment registry. Physical proof of the SWIFT message, the SWIFT formatted purpose code, and the value-date matching the notary signature should be retained for at least six years to survive any AML or tax audit.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade disbursements for the wholesale purchase of urea and potassium chloride must clear through established documentary trade instruments and bank telex transfers. The preferred infra is an irrevocable, transferable documentary letter of credit issued by Banco Santander or BBVA under the Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits (UCP600), designated as payable at sight. For direct supplier payment without LC, the cleanest rail is SWIFT MT103, enabling the supplier side to receive the proceeds on their nostro/SCP account; where a separate cover is required by an intermediate correspondent, an MT202 COVER is used to settle the cover instruction. The SL must provide a complete export package including commercial invoice, certified weight list, port-certified bill of lading, certificate of origin, phytosanitary / customs declaration (DAU), and independent cargo-sampling certificate. Any US-dollar or Latin-American currency disbursement should pass through the banking group’s correspondent clearing network so that no correspondent requires an unduly long time for false-hit reviews. All shortages in payment maturity should be backed by uncommitted credit lines (póliza de crédito con disposición) at the tier-1 bank.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla EUR/USD FX forwards (forward contracts) with a maturity of up to 12 months, executed under a local ISDA or FX Master Agreement with the Spanish tier-1 bank; these must hedge a documented trade or capital position.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on Latin-American restricted-currency pairs such as EUR/BRL, EUR/CLP, EUR/PEN, and EUR/ARS; settlement in euro on the fixing date, permitted only against a verifiable commercial contract or committed future cashflow.
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps (CIRS) for converting USD or Brazilian-Reais debt into euro-denominated liabilities, subject to EMIR margin and trade-reporting requirements.

Simple European-style FX options, including zero-cost collars or range forwards entered into simultaneously with a forward liquidation, with premiums settled from an existing trading account and prohibited if speculative in substance.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% rate for newly created S.L. entities (Art. 29.1 LIS) applicable to the first EUR 300,000 of taxable base in the first two tax periods with a positive taxable base, provided an economic activity is carried on; export/patent box (Art. 23 LIS) – 30% exemption of qualifying patent/certain industrial IP income (10% effective rate); R&D and innovation tax credits up to 25%-42% on qualifying expenditure (Art. 35 LIS); general reserve and special investment reserve for SMEs (net turnover < EUR 10M) under Arts. 101-105 LIS (accelerated amortisation). Group consolidation regime (Art. 55 LIS) is inapplicable to a standalone SL.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited (Art. 26.1 LIS); annual offset cap of 60% of positive taxable base if net turnover >= EUR 20M, 25% if turnover EUR 1M-20M, no percentage cap below EUR 1M, with a guaranteed minimum offset of EUR 1M per period (Art. 26.1 in fine LIS)
